title: Constant speed distance
description: Essential Criteria: The student must correctly calculate the distance traveled by car 1 at constant speed as 5 m.

title: Time saved
description: Essential Criteria: The student must correctly calculate the time saved by car 1 compared to car 2 as 13 s.

title: Deceleration distance calculation
description: Important Criteria: The student must correctly apply the kinematic equation v² - u² = 2as to find the deceleration distances for both cars.

title: Time component breakdown
description: Important Criteria: The student must correctly calculate and sum the deceleration, constant speed, and acceleration times for each car's complete journey.

title: Inclusion of toll time
description: Important Criteria: The student must account for the 10 s toll payment time for car 2 in the total time comparison.

title: Unit consistency
description: Optional Criteria: The student's calculations should maintain consistent units (m, s, m/s²) throughout.

title: Sign error in acceleration
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student incorrectly uses positive acceleration for deceleration phases in the kinematic equations.

title: Distance misinterpretation
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student confuses the total distance to the toll station with the distance traveled during deceleration for car 1.
